breakouts.title: Add timestamp to Footer

clarified_description: Add a 'Last updated' timestamp row to the site-wide footer. The row appears on its own line beneath the existing copyright year, left-aligned to match it. The date is derived from the most recent entry in data/changelog.json and formatted as 'Last updated: DD MMM YYYY'. When the changelog contains no entries the row is omitted entirely — no fallback text is shown.

flows.title: Footer timestamp render logic

must: WHEN a visitor loads any page, the system shall render a row in the site footer displaying the text 'Last updated:' followed by the most recent date in data/changelog.json formatted as DD MMM YYYY.
The system shall derive the displayed date by finding the entry in data/changelog.json with the latest date value.
The system shall format the date as DD MMM YYYY per ANZ Digital Date & Time Display Standard DTS-04 (e.g. '29 Aug 2026' for 2026-08-29T00:00:00.000Z).
IF data/changelog.json contains no entries THEN the system shall not render the timestamp row.
The system shall position the timestamp row on its own line beneath the copyright year, and left-aligned to match it.

outcome: Every page of the sandbox site shows when the changelog was last updated, directly below the copyright line in the footer.
rationale:
Footer self-imports `data/changelog.json` rather than receiving a `lastUpdated` prop from `app/layout.tsx`. This keeps the change self-contained to one file and matches the existing pattern in `app/changelog/page.tsx`. The alternative — passing a prop through `layout.tsx` — adds a call-site change for no gain, since the data is static and Footer is already a Server Component that can read it directly.

The DD MMM YYYY format is mandated by DTS-04 and removes date-format ambiguity across the three markets ANZ Digital serves. The label 'Last updated:' was chosen by the user; it is descriptive without being verbose.

The empty-state decision (hide, not fallback) keeps the footer clean and avoids surfacing a misleading 'Last updated: never' state. A changelog with no entries is an infrastructure condition, not a message for a visitor.

should: The system should wrap the date value in a <time> element with a datetime attribute set to the ISO 8601 date string (e.g. datetime='2026-08-29'), for semantic HTML and screen-reader support.

standards_applied.standard: ANZ Digital — Date & Time Display Standard (DTS-04)

standards_applied.why_not: The feature renders only a reformatted ISO date string sourced from a structured date field in changelog.json. No free-form text from changelog entries (titles, descriptions) is surfaced in the footer, so there is no path through which internal work-tracking references could appear.

swe_constraints: Footer must remain a Server Component — do not add 'use client', useState, or useEffect.
Import changelog data via `import changelog from '@/data/changelog.json'` — the established pattern (see app/changelog/page.tsx).
Match the Tailwind muted text styling of the existing copyright line for the timestamp row.
Render the timestamp row with a conditional expression — omit the element from the DOM entirely when the array is empty; do not hide it with CSS.
No changes to app/layout.tsx are needed; Footer derives the date internally.
Type the imported JSON as an array with a required `date: string` field so TypeScript catches a schema mismatch at build time.
